comments.name: GlobalCitizen_Sophia
comments.content: The US non-farm data is definitely a game-changer, pushing the Fed's hawkish stance further. It's interesting to see the divergence in the market; tech stocks got hit by AI concerns, but AMD still surged. This reflects a shift in investor sentiment, perhaps a rotation out of hyped-up AI concepts into more tangible, chip-level plays. Also, the Texas move on data centers is a big deal for sustainable infrastructure and energy consumption. Globally, these geopolitical tensions in the Middle East are also adding to market uncertainty. We really need to look at this from a macro perspective to understand the ripple effects, both domestically and internationally. It's a complex jigsaw puzzle. 🧩
